author: Ingolf Lohmann
declaration: Ich habe aus Tested Event Model Driven Development nicht nur eine Entwicklungsmethode gemacht, sondern eine ausführbare Sprache mit Entwicklungs-, Debugging-, Test-, Linking- und Effect-Verification-Laufzeit.
evidence_boundary: Presence of this declaration establishes the attributed architecture declaration only. Implementation, conformance, release, Zenodo publication and EFFECT_ACK_DONE remain separately evidence-bound.

atomic_effect_acceptance.semantic_scope: Atomicity applies to the acceptance verdict over one exact bound actual successor; it does not assert CPU, storage, database, transaction, or ACID atomicity of execution.
atomic_effect_acceptance.actual_successor: s_(n+1)^actual is the observed state produced by EXECUTE, not the intended state.
atomic_effect_acceptance.bind_rule: BIND the actual successor together with subject identity, provenance, artifact identity, and execution identity before acceptance.
atomic_effect_acceptance.readback_rule: Acceptance evidence is produced after the effect, bound to the same successor, and must not be derived solely from the executor's own success return.
atomic_effect_acceptance.acceptance_predicate: ACCEPTED(b,e,C_scope) := conjunction of every predicate p(b,e) in the explicit acceptance scope C_scope.
atomic_effect_acceptance.continuation_rule: If acceptance is false, a safely bindable actual successor becomes the next bound subject; otherwise fail closed with BLOCK_OR_ISOLATE.
atomic_effect_acceptance.public_artifact_readback: Required only when C_scope requires a public artifact state.

scientific_positioning.research_subject: Composition of exact-successor binding, provenance-bound evidence, fresh non-self-confirming readback, and an indivisible effect-acceptance verdict as runtime release semantics.
scientific_positioning.novelty_boundary: Repository or Zenodo persistence establishes attribution and fixed bytes, not scientific novelty or priority; systematic prior-art review and independent assessment remain required.
